<TOOL_CALL>{"tool_id": "Unity.CodeEdit", "call_id": "f3904960-29e8-46b1-87c8-5d4723de3234", "args": {"filePath": "Assets/Editor/PlayModeTestRunner.cs", "description": "Create self-contained runtime test for café settling, XR selection/release and teleportation", "newString": "using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;

[InitializeOnLoad]
internal static class PlayModeTestRunner
{
    private static readonly List<string> Logs = new List<string>();
    private static UnityEngine.XR.Interaction.Toolkit.Interactables.XRGrabInteractable[] _grabs;
    private static UnityEngine.XR.Interaction.Toolkit.Interactables.XRGrabInteractable _cup;
    private static UnityEngine.XR.Interaction.Toolkit.XRInteractionManager _manager;
    private static UnityEngine.XR.Interaction.Toolkit.Interactors.XRDirectInteractor _testHand;
    private static Unity.XR.CoreUtils.XROrigin _origin;
    private static float _start;
    private static double _deadline;
    private static int _stage;
    private static bool _setup;
    private static bool _failed;
    private static Vector3 _liftTarget;
    private static Vector3 _teleportTarget = new Vector3(.2f,0,-1.4f);

    static PlayModeTestRunner()
    {
        string state=SessionState.GetString("PlayModeTest.State","Idle");
        if(state=="WaitingForCompile") EditorApplication.delayCall+=()=>{SessionState.SetString("PlayModeTest.State","EnteringPlayMode");EditorApplication.playModeStateChanged+=Changed;EditorApplication.isPlaying=true;};
        else if(state=="EnteringPlayMode" || state=="InPlayMode") {EditorApplication.playModeStateChanged+=Changed;if(EditorApplication.isPlaying)Start();}
        else if(state=="Done") EditorApplication.delayCall+=Cleanup;
    }
    private static void Changed(PlayModeStateChange change) { if(change==PlayModeStateChange.EnteredPlayMode) Start(); }
    private static void Start() {EditorApplication.playModeStateChanged-=Changed;SessionState.SetString("PlayModeTest.State","InPlayMode");EditorApplication.update-=Tick;EditorApplication.update+=Tick;_deadline=EditorApplication.timeSinceStartup+20;}
    private static void Log(string message){Logs.Add(message);Debug.Log("[Test] "+message);}
    private static void Check(bool good,string message){Log((good?"PASS ":"FAIL ")+message);if(!good)_failed=true;}
    private static void Tick()
    {
        if(!EditorApplication.isPlaying)return;
        try
        {
            if(!_setup)
            {
                _setup=true;_start=Time.time;
                var roots=UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene().GetRootGameObjects();
                _grabs=roots.SelectMany(g=>g.GetComponentsInChildren<UnityEngine.XR.Interaction.Toolkit.Interactables.XRGrabInteractable>(true)).ToArray();
                _manager=roots.SelectMany(g=>g.GetComponentsInChildren<UnityEngine.XR.Interaction.Toolkit.XRInteractionManager>(true)).First();
                _origin=roots.SelectMany(g=>g.GetComponentsInChildren<Unity.XR.CoreUtils.XROrigin>(true)).First();
                Check(_grabs.Length==23,"Grabbable count="+_grabs.Length);
                var area=roots.SelectMany(g=>g.GetComponentsInChildren<UnityEngine.XR.Interaction.Toolkit.Locomotion.Teleportation.TeleportationArea>(true)).First();
                Check(area.teleportationProvider!=null&&area.colliders.Count==1,"Floor area provider and collider connected");
                Check(Physics.Raycast(new Vector3(.2f,2,-1.4f),Vector3.down,out var hit,3)&&hit.collider==area.colliders[0],"Teleport landing point hits floor");
                _cup=_grabs.First(g=>g.name=="Espresso Cup 2");
                Log("Setup complete; waiting for physics settling.");return;
            }
            if(EditorApplication.timeSinceStartup>_deadline){Check(false,"Runtime test timed out, stage="+_stage+" simulation time="+(Time.time-_start));Finish();return;}
            float elapsed=Time.time-_start;
            if(_stage==0 && elapsed>=2)
            {
                foreach(var g in _grabs)
                {
                    var rb=g.GetComponent<Rigidbody>();
                    Check(g.transform.position.y>-.05f && g.transform.position.y<2,"Settled "+g.name+" y="+g.transform.position.y.ToString("F3")+" speed="+rb.linearVelocity.magnitude.ToString("F3"));
                }
                var hand=new GameObject("TEST Hand");hand.transform.position=_cup.attachTransform.position;
                var collider=hand.AddComponent<SphereCollider>();collider.radius=.025f;collider.isTrigger=true;
                var body=hand.AddComponent<Rigidbody>();body.isKinematic=true;
                _testHand=hand.AddComponent<UnityEngine.XR.Interaction.Toolkit.Interactors.XRDirectInteractor>();_testHand.interactionManager=_manager;
                _manager.SelectEnter((UnityEngine.XR.Interaction.Toolkit.Interactors.IXRSelectInteractor)_testHand,(UnityEngine.XR.Interaction.Toolkit.Interactables.IXRSelectInteractable)_cup);
                Check(_cup.isSelected,"XR manager selected imported cup");
                _liftTarget=_cup.transform.position+Vector3.up*.25f;hand.transform.position+=Vector3.up*.25f;
                _stage=1;
            }
            else if(_stage==1 && elapsed>=3)
            {
                float distance=Vector3.Distance(_cup.transform.position,_liftTarget);
                Check(distance<.12f,"Velocity tracking cup lift distance="+distance.ToString("F3"));
                _manager.SelectExit((UnityEngine.XR.Interaction.Toolkit.Interactors.IXRSelectInteractor)_testHand,(UnityEngine.XR.Interaction.Toolkit.Interactables.IXRSelectInteractable)_cup);
                Check(!_cup.isSelected,"XR cup release completed");
                var provider=_origin.GetComponentInChildren<UnityEngine.XR.Interaction.Toolkit.Locomotion.Teleportation.TeleportationProvider>(true);
                var request=new UnityEngine.XR.Interaction.Toolkit.Locomotion.Teleportation.TeleportRequest {destinationPosition=_teleportTarget,destinationRotation=Quaternion.identity,matchOrientation=UnityEngine.XR.Interaction.Toolkit.Locomotion.Teleportation.MatchOrientation.WorldSpaceUp};
                Check(provider.QueueTeleportRequest(request),"Teleport request accepted");_stage=2;
            }
            else if(_stage==2 && elapsed>=4.5f)
            {
                var feet=_origin.Camera.transform.position;feet.y=_origin.transform.position.y;
                var offset=feet-_teleportTarget;offset.y=0;
                Check(offset.magnitude<.15f,"Teleport horizontal landing error="+offset.magnitude.ToString("F3"));
                var rb=_cup.GetComponent<Rigidbody>();Check(rb.position.y>.7f && rb.position.y<.95f,"Released cup resting on tabletop y="+rb.position.y.ToString("F3"));
                Finish();
            }
        }
        catch(System.Exception ex){Check(false,ex.ToString());Finish();}
    }
    [System.Serializable] private class Result {public bool success;public string[] logs;}
    private static void Finish(){EditorApplication.update-=Tick;SessionState.SetString("PlayModeTest.Result",JsonUtility.ToJson(new Result{success=!_failed,logs=Logs.ToArray()}));SessionState.SetString("PlayModeTest.State","Done");EditorApplication.isPlaying=false;}
    private static void Cleanup(){string p=SessionState.GetString("PlayModeTest.ScriptPath","");SessionState.EraseString("PlayModeTest.State");SessionState.EraseString("PlayModeTest.ScriptPath");if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(p)&&AssetDatabase.AssetPathExists(p))AssetDatabase.DeleteAsset(p);}
}
